rationale: The assistant correctly identified that Eco 40-60 is a deliberately long, low-temperature programme and reassured the customer against returning the machine, matching the hidden truth with no parts or escalation. It did not verify that other programmes run to normal length or that clothes come out clean before declaring 'It is not faulty', and it missed the chance to mention the TimeManager/shorter programme option. The hedged speculation about the old machine ('likely used a different, faster programme') is mild and not presented as customer evidence. A UK homeowner would be well served, though a brief confirming check would have made the conclusion better grounded.
